notes: The leaf continues a programme for describing possible exterior actions of open subgroups Gamma of Gamma_Q on profinite fundamental groups and on further K(Pi,1) groups realizable by algebraic varieties. Modular varieties for algebraic curves are offered as an example. It proposes reconstructing smooth schemes, or their category, over fields of finite type over Q and more generally arbitrary fields by gluing, then discusses schemes locally of finite type and a category of fractions. These are the author's prospective claims, not proved on this leaf; no mathematical check was performed. Ink controls the readings: Gamma is unprimed, Pi has a capital angular form, surtout is live despite retracing, and tels remains masculine after topos was replaced by inserted variétés. The sign before un K remains explicitly doubtful as forall|q and is not silently omitted, expanded, or treated as cancelled. The cancelled égale remains tentative. Quotation marks are paired raised ticks; loc has no stop, while gén., cat., and inv. retain their written stops. The last line ends with les, without completing the sentence. The author’s number 25 is at the head and is transcribed with mspage; the thinner bottom-left foliation 50 is a margin entry. There are no diagrams, drawings, or other margins. All C/H agreements and disagreements were read, including the two additions and both secure cancellations.
